module.Title: Require Two Conditions
module.Teaching: The && operator means AND. Both conditions must be true for the complete expression to be true.
module.PredictionExplanation: AND requires every connected condition to be true.
module.RecallPrompt: Create safeToMine using hasPickaxe AND isAlive.
module.TransferPrompt: Create canEnter using hasKey AND doorOpen.
module.PreviewMessage: Mining can now require both equipment and survival.
